about.description: ETF perpetual market tracking the Sprott Uranium Miners ETF. Users get synthetic exposure to a uranium-focused listed fund rather than ownership of ETF shares or redemption rights in the fund, with pricing referencing the ETF's public market price. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
